name: 工具箱
author: Yggdrasil
description: 示例插件：向 Agent 提供**新工具**（与内置 calc / now 同列，用 call_tool 调），而不是新操作。这八个都是它自己做不到、或做起来容易出错的。

tools.name: stats
tools.label: 数值统计
tools.description: Median / mean / stddev (population and sample) / percentiles (p25..p99) / IQR for a list of numbers. Use it instead of doing statistics in your head — the built-in calc only evaluates one arithmetic expression and cannot do these. Pass numbers separated by commas, spaces or newlines.

params.name: values
params.description: the numbers, separated by comma / space / newline

values.description: the numbers, separated by comma / space / newline

tools.name: regex_extract
tools.label: 正则提取
tools.description: Run a regular expression over text and return **every** match with its capture groups (plus a flattened list when you ask for one group). Use it whenever you must extract identifiers / prices / URLs from a longer body: you cannot reliably enumerate exact matches by reading, and a wrong answer looks plausible. The global flag is forced on.

params.name: text
params.description: the text to search

params.name: pattern
params.description: the regex source, WITHOUT the surrounding slashes

params.name: flags
params.description: extra flags: i m s u y (g is always on)

params.name: group
params.description: if given, also return a flat list of that group (1-based number, or a named group)

params.name: limit
params.description: max matches, default 100, max 500

pattern.description: the regex source, WITHOUT the surrounding slashes

flags.description: extra flags: i m s u y (g is always on)

group.description: if given, also return a flat list of that group (1-based number, or a named group)

tools.name: json_query
tools.label: JSON 取值
tools.description: Pull just the fields you need out of a JSON payload: exact, and it keeps the payload out of your context. The path syntax is identical to a plugin endpoint's pick — dot separated, with [] on an array segment (data.items[].name). Pass the JSON as a string, or as an object/array directly.

params.name: json
params.description: the JSON to query (a string, or the object/array itself)

params.name: path
params.description: field path(s), one per line, e.g. data.items[].name

params.name: maxItems
params.description: cap per array, default 10, max 50

json.description: the JSON to query (a string, or the object/array itself)

path.description: field path(s), one per line, e.g. data.items[].name

tools.name: diff_text
tools.label: 逐行 diff
tools.description: Line-by-line diff of two texts: added / removed counts plus a unified-diff style body with context. Use it before writing a patch so you state exactly which lines change — counting changed lines by eye is where patches most often go wrong. Answers "too large for an exact diff" honestly rather than guessing.

params.name: before
params.description: the original text

params.name: after
params.description: the changed text

params.name: context
params.description: unchanged context lines around each change, default 2, max 20

context.description: unchanged context lines around each change, default 2, max 20

tools.name: date_math
tools.label: 日期运算
tools.description: Date arithmetic on a real calendar (month lengths, leap years) with an IANA timezone: add a span to a date, or measure the gap between two dates. Units are y / mo / w / d / h / mi / s (English words also work) — deliberately not a bare "m", the classic minute-vs-month bug. The built-in now only reports the current instant and does no arithmetic.

params.name: base
params.description: starting instant, ISO format or "now" (default now)

params.name: add
params.description: how much to add, e.g. "3d", "-2w", "1mo", "36h"

params.name: until
params.description: instead of add: another instant; returns the gap to it

params.name: tz
params.description: IANA timezone for the local rendering, default UTC

base.description: starting instant, ISO format or "now" (default now)

until.description: instead of add: another instant; returns the gap to it

tz.description: IANA timezone for the local rendering, default UTC

tools.name: table_parse
tools.label: 解析表格
tools.description: Parse CSV / TSV into JSON rows with named columns. Quoted fields are handled properly — a delimiter or newline inside quotes stays part of the field, and "" is one quote character — which is exactly where splitting on commas silently shifts every row. The delimiter is auto-detected unless you pass one.

params.name: csv
params.description: the table text

params.name: delimiter
params.description: auto (default), or one of , ; | or tab

params.name: header
params.description: is the first row a header, default true

params.name: limit
params.description: max rows, default 100, max 500

delimiter.description: auto (default), or one of , ; | or tab

header.description: is the first row a header, default true

tools.name: encode
tools.label: 编码与摘要
tools.description: Encode / decode text: base64 both ways, URL, hex, plus sha256 and a char/byte length. Needed for things that are easy to get subtly wrong — a data: URI to embed a workspace file, a URL-encoded query value, a checksum. sha256 is implemented here instead of via crypto.subtle, because subtle exists only in a secure context and this app may be served over plain http on a LAN address.

params.name: op
params.description: base64_encode | base64_decode | url_encode | url_decode | hex_encode | hex_decode | sha256 | length

params.name: text
params.description: the text to process

op.description: base64_encode | base64_decode | url_encode | url_decode | hex_encode | hex_decode | sha256 | length

tools.name: decode_layers
tools.label: 层层解码
tools.description: Peel the escaping layers off a value and report what each layer was (JSON string, JS escapes, percent-encoding, HTML entities). Use it when an API hands back something like an escaped JSON string inside a string — guessing the nesting depth by eye is a common source of wrong conclusions. base64 is only suggested, never auto-decoded, since a string that merely happens to be valid base64 would decode into garbage.

params.name: text
params.description: the escaped value

params.name: maxDepth
params.description: how many layers to peel at most, default 5, max 10

maxDepth.description: how many layers to peel at most, default 5, max 10
